hero.title: Ask what you owe. Get the answer — and the report.
hero.lead: Upload your Amazon VAT file once. From then on, just ask — grounded in your figures, never guessed.
hero.artAlt: FiscorAI soft-3D product scene with VAT report, euro coin, and marketplace carts

steps.title: Three steps. Upload to answer.
steps.lead: A continuous loop from CSV to chat — no dashboards to configure, nothing to remap.
steps.s1Body: Drop your VAT transactions CSV once. No template, no column renaming — FiscorAI reads Amazon’s export as-is.
steps.s1Alt: 3D morphic icon of an Amazon VAT CSV upload
steps.s2Body: Every row is parsed, matched to the correct VAT rate by country, and scanned for wrong rates, refund anomalies, and unclassified rows.
steps.s2Alt: 3D morphic icon of automated VAT processing
steps.s3Body: Just ask — “vat this quarter”, “what changed”, “send me the PDF” — answers from your real figures, never estimates.
steps.s3Alt: 3D morphic icon of the FiscorAI chat analyst

pipeline.title: The actual pipeline, animated on repeat
pipeline.body: This is the real upload-to-report flow, looping so you can watch the whole thing without lifting a finger — parsing every row, matching VAT rates by country, and building the report.

chat.title: Not a dashboard. A conversation.
chat.body: Casual phrasing is fine, and every figure it gives you is computed from your data, never estimated. Ask a follow-up, ask for a comparison, or just ask for the file.
chat.a1: Q2 2026: you owe about €4,812.30 in VAT on net sales of €21,340.10 — refunds were €918.20.
chat.a2: VAT due is up 12% quarter-on-quarter, mostly from higher Germany sales. Refund rate is steady at 4.3%, right at your 12-month norm.
chat.u3: can I get that as a pdf?
chat.a3: Here's your Q2 2026 VAT report — ready to download or hand to your accountant.

offer.title: One upload, a structured VAT activity report
offer.lead: The report, source checks, and someone to ask about it — all from a single Amazon transaction file upload.
offer.i1Title: One chat, answers from your data
offer.i1Body: Ask in plain language — "vat this quarter", "what changed", "send me the PDF" — and get answers computed from your uploaded source rows.
offer.i2Body: The chat hands you the exact PDF or Excel file as soon as you need it — no menu, no period picker to hunt through, just ask.
offer.i3Body: Net sales, refunds, source-reported VAT amounts, and scheme/responsibility context for each destination in your file — ready to export.
offer.i4Body: Every upload is scanned for period mismatches, currency mixing, unresolved refunds, and missing context — the same checks, every time.

faq.title: Popular questions
faq.q1: Where does the AI come in?
faq.a1: It's the main way you use FiscorAI. Ask in plain language and the analyst reads your aggregates and flags — never your raw rows — to answer, and hands you the PDF or Excel report the moment you ask for it. Every number it gives you is computed, not generated.
faq.a2: Your Amazon VAT transactions report, or the standard transaction report. CSV or TXT, any date range.
faq.a3: No. FiscorAI does the arithmetic and tells you what is due where and when. Filing stays with you or your accountant.
faq.a4: Your file is processed for your report and deleted on request. It is never shared with other sellers or used to train anything.

finalCta.title: One upload. Then just ask.
finalCta.lead: Free, no card, deletes on request. The report is yours either way.
